caption: The drawing shows a geometric pattern occupying the top left quadrant of the page, resembling a quilt or tile design. The composition consists of alternating squares arranged in a grid, each rotated to appear diamond-shaped. There are two types of squares: one features a floral motif drawn in light brown pencil, with swirling, circular lines; the other type contains a blue geometric motif that resembles a stylized flower or leaf pattern, composed of several pointed segments filled in with solid blue and accented with a dotted texture. The overall design is bordered by two blue bands on the right and lower edges, with a final surrounding border made of parallel diagonal gray or light brown pencil lines. The remainder of the page is empty and off-white in color.
title: Quilt
